post.description: Ingest bounded UTF-8 TXT, Markdown or Python; return success only after atomic source/job publication.

file.description: One UTF-8 TXT, Markdown or Python file, at most 1 MiB; or a text-layer PDF, at most 8 MiB and 32 pages, only when capabilities.pdf_ingestion.available is true. No OCR or visual understanding.

upload_location.description: Optional JSON UploadLocation for new sources: group_id, relative path including filename, and folder_totals (recursive selected-file counts for each ancestor, root first). Display metadata only; never a server path.

get.description: Expose active processing metadata without paths or a fabricated original download.
Read one active-version keyset page, rejecting stale or foreign cursors.
Read durable last-confirmed state without the idempotency key or owner token.
Load the authoritative YAML directly for the local application, without keys or sessions.

put.description: Revalidate and atomically save against the loaded revision; activation remains explicit.

post.description: Return canonical diagnostics without modifying saved configuration.

FolderState.title: FolderState
FolderState.description: Recursive status of documents actually present in one corpus snapshot.

PdfIngestionCapabilities.title: PdfIngestionCapabilities
PdfIngestionCapabilities.description: Text-layer availability is independent from original evidence, OCR and visual semantics.

RevealSourceRequest.title: RevealSourceRequest
RevealSourceRequest.description: Native selection accepts source identity in the route, never a browser path.

UploadLocation.title: UploadLocation
UploadLocation.description: Display-only location in one folder selection, never a server filesystem path.
